parameters.query: SELECT * FROM ops.v_llm_cost_daily WHERE cost_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY cost_date DESC, total_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT * FROM ops.v_llm_cost_by_workflow ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM ops.v_llm_cost_month_to_date ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at)::DATE AS week_start, SUM(total_cost_usd) AS week_cost FROM ops.llm_usage WHERE status='success' AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 weeks' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 2;
